targets.empty: No targets detected yet. Commands from the shell hook auto-catalog targets.
targets.noEvidence: No evidence linked to this target.

loot.empty: No credentials or secrets detected yet.
loot.emptyDesc: Auto-scans shell output for password hashes, API keys, JWTs, private keys, database URLs, and CTF flags.
loot.openInTimelineHint: Jump to this discovery on the timeline to see the surrounding activity.
bookmarks.title: Marks ({{count}})
bookmarks.pin: Pin this mark to the top
loot.exportHint: Save all loot events as JSON
loot.noMatches: No loot matches the current filter.
scope.exportHint: Save all scope violations as JSON
bookmarks.placeholder: Click + Capture to bookmark the current page
bookmarks.placeholderSub: Auto-captures browser URL, page title, and your current IP
bookmarks.cdpHint: Chrome CDP not connected. Launch Chrome with --remote-debugging-port={{port}} for auto-capture.
marker.title: New Event Marker
terminal.restart: Restart this tab's shell (keeps slot + label)
terminal.closeConfirm: Closing "{{label}}" kills its PTY session. Continue?
terminal.searchPlaceholder: Search terminal buffer… Enter = next, Shift+Enter = previous
statusBar.captureDark: Recording ON but no capture source is feeding events — check hooks / mitmproxy / builtin terminal
statusBar.capturePartial: Recording ON but some capture sources have been idle for 10+ min
overlay.unknownHint: Set Safe IPs / Exposed IPs in Settings ▸ Network to classify.
browser.hint: Open a Chromium browser routed through your proxy, with CDP enabled and an isolated profile. Configure in Settings ▸ Data.
settings.browserHint: Launches a Chromium browser with --proxy-server (so mitmproxy captures the traffic), --remote-debugging-port (so QuickMarks can read the active tab), and a project-local profile so these flags never touch your daily browsing.
settings.browserIgnoreCert: Ignore certificate errors (needed for mitmproxy interception)
settings.browserNotFound: No Chromium-based browser found — set a path above
settings.agents.hint: Watches AI-coding-agent transcript files and derives per-turn audit events into the hash chain. Off means no agent conversation, tool call, or response is captured — the sidecar files stay untouched.
settings.agents.enableHint: Watches ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl. Future OpenCode / Codex adapters will register here too (v0.8.1+).
settings.agents.emitThinkingHint: Emits `agent.thinking` events for assistant reasoning blocks. Off by default — blocks are large and mostly meta. Turn on for AI-safety red-team or tool-use policy audits.
settings.agents.selfExclusionHint: A `.redlog-app-root` marker file in a project cwd opts that repo out of tailing — used to prevent RedLog watching its own dev sessions. Commit the marker to any repo you don't want tailed.
settings.name: Name
settings.whitelist: Safe IPs — where it's OK to attack from (VPN/VPS exits). External IP matching → SAFE (green).
settings.blacklist: Exposed IPs — your own fixed IPs (home ISP, office). External IP matching → EXPOSED (red, identity leak).
settings.ipModeHint: How the external IP is fetched. DNS is quieter and not rate-limited but can be blocked on restrictive networks; Auto tries DNS first, then HTTP.
settings.showWifiNameHint: macOS hides the Wi-Fi SSID behind Location Services. Enabling this asks for permission once so the HUD can show the real network name instead of a generic "Wi-Fi". Location data never leaves your machine.
settings.pollingOpsecHint: Each poll is an outbound request to a third party from the operator's box. At 10s that is ~8,600 requests a day — a periodic beacon a defender can fingerprint. 60s or more is a safer default; point the providers below at your own endpoint to avoid third parties entirely.
settings.confirmations: Readings required before the address changes
settings.confirmationsHint: Egress behind CGNAT or a load-balanced pool answers differently each poll. Requiring several identical reads stops the safety badge flickering between SAFE and EXPOSED.
settings.ipProvidersHint: Tried in order until one answers. Must return JSON with an "ip" field.
settings.vpnAdaptersHint: Which VPN adapter names to look for when checking whether a tunnel is up. Toggle built-in presets or add custom patterns (case-insensitive regex matched against the interface name).
settings.overlayShowMark: Show Mark button in the expanded overlay
settings.overlayShowMarkHint: Keeps the collapsed overlay minimal; the Mark button only appears when expanded.
settings.overlayFlashExposedHint: When the external IP hits the blacklist (EXPOSED), flash the whole HUD frame red so it's hard to miss. Off leaves just the red status dot pulsing.
settings.overlayScaleHint: Scales every font size + padding together; the window auto-resizes to fit.
settings.overlayEmphasizeIpHint: Bumps the external IP an extra ~1.4× on top of the overall scale, so an OPSEC glance always lands on it first.
settings.overlayPassThroughHint: The HUD stops receiving clicks — stray drags won't steal focus from Burp / a browser sitting under it. Opacity drops so you can see it's non-interactive.
settings.clipboardEnable: Log clipboard changes (sensitive; off by default)
settings.clipboardEnableHint: Records the moment a credential/token was copied. Content is run through loot detection + redaction; only SHA-256, length, line count and matched credential types are stored. Raw text never lands. Detected credentials get their own loot event.
settings.clipboardStorePreviewHint: Keep a redacted preview alongside the hash for later cross-reference. Leave off if you're worried about redaction gaps.
settings.fileWatcherEnable: Log file activity (opt-in; can be noisy)
settings.fileWatcherEnableHint: Emits file_transfer events when files in the watched paths are created/modified/deleted. node_modules/, .git/, dist/, out/, build/, .DS_Store and editor temp files are ignored by default.
settings.fileWatcherIgnoreHint: Gitignore-style globs on top of the built-in defaults. One per line.
settings.processMonitorEnableHint: Polls ps every 500ms; emits process_spawn / process_exit events for the new lane. Windows is not supported yet. RedLog's own processes are ignored automatically.
settings.processMonitorIgnoreHint: Match by leading token (first word or basename). Case-sensitive.
settings.overlayShowInDockHint: Opening the HUD otherwise makes RedLog Dock-less. Off = run from the menu bar / HUD only, no Dock icon.
settings.screenshot.intervalHint: Auto-capture the desktop at the chosen cadence. Identical frames are deduped by SHA-256 so an idle screen doesn't spam the chain.
settings.checkUpdateHint: Checks GitHub for a newer release. RedLog also checks automatically at launch.
settings.qualityHint: Higher = better quality, larger files. Default: 85
settings.exportHint: Exports all events and config as a single JSON file.
settings.exportBundleHint: Full sanitized evidence pack (events.jsonl, chain anchors, screenshots, casts, operators) plus a standalone Python chain verifier. Hand-deliver or attach.
settings.warnOnViolationHint: When a command's target is outside scope but shares a root domain with a scope target, raise a red badge + scope_violation event. Excluded targets always warn regardless. RedLog only records — it never blocks a command.
settings.scopeFileLabel: Load targets from file (JSON or plain text, one per line)
settings.scopeFileHint: Absolute path to a scope file. Targets are merged with the list above.
settings.restartHint: Applies immediately (changing engagement/operator id needs reopening the project)
settings.autoSaveHint: Changes save automatically and apply live (changing engagement/operator id needs reopening the project)
settings.hookWatchPaths.title: Claude Code Hook — Watch Paths
settings.hookWatchPaths.hint: Only Claude Code sessions whose working directory matches a path listed here will be logged. If the list is empty, all sessions are logged. Add your engagement's working directory to scope capture.
settings.hookWatchPaths.empty: No watch paths — all Claude Code sessions are logged. Add your project directory to scope capture.
settings.integrityHint: The event chain is anchored to public OpenTimestamps calendars every hour. Each receipt lets any auditor prove the chain existed at that time — verifiable independently with the `ots` CLI.
settings.integrityNoAnchors: No anchors yet. Click Anchor now to submit the current chain head.
settings.integrityVerifiedOk: Chain intact: latest anchor covers {{n}} events, current chain has {{m}}.
settings.integrityVerifiedBad: MISMATCH: latest anchor covered {{n}} events, current chain has {{m}} — investigate.
confirm.deleteProjectDesc: Deleting {{name}} is permanent. There is no undo and no recovery path.
confirm.deleteBookmarkDesc: This mark will be permanently removed.
timeline.minimapHint: Drag to zoom to a time window · click to jump
timeline.noEventsDesc: Events will appear here as they are captured from shell, clipboard, screenshots, and other monitors.
timeline.laneChipHint: Click to toggle {{lane}}; Alt/Option-click = solo this lane
timeline.openSidecarHint: Reveal the archived .jsonl in Finder/Explorer — this is the verbatim copy of the agent's own transcript covered by this snapshot's sha256.
timeline.openSidecarFailed: Could not open sidecar (file moved or retention pruned?)
timeline.detail.truncatedHint: Stream exceeded the 100 KB cap — remainder discarded by the hook.
timeline.detail.previewCut: … showing first {{shown}} of {{total}} · use Copy full for the rest
timeline.help.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
timeline.help.focusChain: Toggle focus-chain mode on selected event
timeline.help.walk: Walk selection up/down the visible list
timeline.help.zoom: Zoom a time range (drag on the minimap)
timeline.help.expandCluster: Expand a cluster of overlapping events
timeline.help.jumpCause: Jump to the event that caused this one
timeline.help.copyFull: Copy full untruncated body to clipboard
timeline.collapseAgent.label: collapse agent
timeline.collapseAgent.hint: Hide per-turn AI-agent events (keeps snapshot + session_end)
timeline.collapseAgent.hidden: Hiding {{count}} per-turn agent events — click to show all
timeline.focusChain.enterHint: Press f to focus this chain
timeline.anomalies.tooltip: Dim every event without a chain-integrity flag (clock anomaly, orphan recovery, evidence removal, anchor failure, chain break)
timeline.auditorView.tooltip: Hide logged-tier rows (DNS/HTTP/browser-console/agent-thinking heartbeats) so the chained audit chain is what the reviewer sees. Off by default — flip on before an auditor walks the timeline.
timeline.brokenChain.banner: ⛓️‍💥 Chain broken at event {{brokenAtId}}… (walked {{walked}}). All events after are unverified.
timeline.search.hint: Press / to filter, Escape to clear
timeline.palette.footer: Enter to jump · Esc to close
timeline.views.empty: No saved views yet. Zoom to a moment, then save it.
screenshots.emptyDesc: Screenshots are captured automatically on idle or manually via the capture button.
project.warnOnViolationHint: Same-root out-of-scope targets → red badge + event. Off has no effect on raw command recording.
settings.profileHint: Export config as a .yaml file to share scope, IP safety, and engagement settings with your team.
settings.hooksHint: RedLog auto-detects installed CLI tools and can configure hooks to capture their activity. Enable a hook to start recording events from that tool.
settings.hookManualNote: RedLog must be running — these hooks only record while the app is open.
plugins.hint: Plugins extend RedLog with capture integrations, detection rules, event types and — when you trust them — tools. Drop a plugin folder in the plugins directory and reload.
plugins.empty: No plugins found. Add one under ~/.redlog/plugins/<id>/ (with a plugin.json) and Reload.
plugins.dir: User plugins load from ~/.redlog/plugins/. See docs/plugin-development.md to build one.
plugins.consentTitle: Trust this plugin to run code inside RedLog?
plugins.consentBody: "{name}" ships code that RedLog will execute in an isolated process. Only trust plugins from a source you trust.
plugins.consentWarn: Trust is pinned to the plugin's current code. If the code changes, trust is revoked until you review it again.
settings.scopeExportHint: Exports only events matching configured scope targets. Use this when uploading logs to a remote server — out-of-scope data is excluded.
timeline.detail.ioOnDisk: output recorded — {{size}} of session capture, expand below to read it
timeline.detail.ioUnbracketed: output not bracketed — RedLog could not match this command to a span of the session recording. Try the full session replay below.
timeline.detail.ioNotCaptured: output not captured — external shells record the command only. Prefix with `redlog-run` to capture stdout/stderr, or use the built-in terminal.
capture.manageHint: Show every source, including ones that are off or not installed, with controls to change either
capture.noneEnabled: No capture source is switched on — RedLog is recording nothing.
capture.allGood: All good — {{active}} source(s) delivering, nothing needs attention.
capture.setupIntro: Nothing is feeding the timeline yet. Wire up capture in order:
capture.setupAlmost: Capture is set up — it just needs activity to start recording:
overlay.markQuickHint: Drop a timestamped marker now — no dialog, keeps your focus where it is
overlay.markDetailHint: Open the marker dialog to add a title, notes and severity (raises the main window)
overlay.keepOpenOnHint: Staying open. Click to let it auto-collapse after 8s again.
overlay.keepOpenOffHint: Auto-collapses after 8s of inactivity. Click to keep it open.
timeline.detail.httpBodyNotCaptured: response body not captured — {{size}} of {{type}}. mitmproxy stores a 2 KB preview of textual responses only.
timeline.detail.httpBodyBinary: response body not captured — {{size}} of {{type}}, which is not a textual type.
transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.empty: Nothing captured yet, or everything is filtered out.
transcript.note.recorded: output recorded — {{size}} of session capture, open this event on the Timeline to replay it
transcript.note.unbracketed: output not bracketed — use the full session replay on the Timeline
timeline.compressGaps.label: skip idle
timeline.compressGaps.hint: Collapse stretches longer than 10 minutes with no events, so dense work gets the width instead of the quiet. The axis stops being proportional while this is on — each collapsed stretch is drawn as a hatched break with its duration.
settings.wsl.title: WSL Distributions
settings.wsl.networkNat: Networking: NAT — localhost unreachable from WSL
settings.wsl.networkNotConfigured: Networking: not configured — WSL may not reach localhost
settings.wsl.stopped: Distro stopped — start it to manage hooks
settings.wsl.noWsl: WSL not detected on this system
settings.wsl.hookInstallFailed: Could not install the hook in {{distro}}
settings.wsl.hookInstallFailedWhy: The distro answered, but writing the shell profile did not succeed. It may be read-only, or another process holds it.
settings.wsl.hookUninstallFailed: Could not remove the hook from {{distro}}
settings.wsl.hookUninstallFailedWhy: The distro answered, but editing the shell profile did not succeed. The hook is still active.
settings.wsl.distroUnreachableWhy: The distro did not respond. It may be stopped — start it from Windows, then try again.
toast.exportFailedWhy: Nothing was written. The destination may be unwritable, or the export was cancelled.
browser.failedWhy: The browser binary could not be started. Check the path and proxy in Settings ▸ Browser.
screenshots.deleteFailed: Could not delete the image file
screenshots.deleteFailedWhy: The event stays in the chain either way — only the JPEG was going to be removed.
capture.actionFailedWhy: The hook was not changed. The shell profile may be read-only, or the path no longer exists.
transcript.copyFailedWhy: The clipboard refused the write. Another application may be holding it.
project.openMissingWhy: The folder is gone or on a volume that is not mounted.
confirm.ackDefault: I understand this cannot be undone.
settings.cdpNotConnectedTitle: Chrome is not answering on the debugging port
settings.hookFailedWhy: The shell profile was not written. It may be read-only, or the path in Settings no longer exists.
plugins.grantFailedWhy: The plugin stays unable to run. Its manifest may have changed since it was installed.
settings.anchorFailedWhy: Events keep being chained, but nothing timestamps them externally until an anchor lands. Check network access and retry.
settings.integrityNoAnchorsWhy: There is nothing to anchor yet — the chain is empty.
project.openFailedWhy: Nothing was changed or loaded. The database may be locked by another RedLog window.
timeline.saveFailedWhy: Your text is still in the field — copy it before closing the panel.
timeline.openSidecarFailedWhy: The file may have been moved or deleted since the event was recorded.
terminal.tabClosedWhy: The shell process ended. Undo opens a new one — scrollback does not come back.
toast.recordingPausedWhy: Capture sources stop feeding the timeline. Your markers and RedLog’s own audit events keep recording.
plugins.disabledWhy: Not written yet — undo within 8 seconds and nothing reaches the audit log.
targets.addedToScopeWhy: Not written yet — undo within 8 seconds and nothing reaches the audit log.
settings.hookRemovedWhy: Not written yet — undo within 8 seconds and the profile is never touched.
issues.captureDetail: Events are still being written, but at least one source has stopped producing — the gap will be in the timeline, not in an error.
issues.chainBroken: The evidence chain does not verify
issues.chainBrokenDetail: A row between the anchor and now does not hash to its successor. Export a bundle before doing anything else.
fatal.title: {{view}} stopped working
fatal.why: Nothing has been lost — events already recorded are on disk and the chain is intact. Only this view stopped rendering.
fatal.scrubbed: Paths are reduced to the app bundle, and your username and project name are replaced. Read it before sending — this is exactly what gets shared.
timeline.help.walkCrossLane: Change lane — lands on the nearest event in time
timeline.help.walkState: Skip to the next event carrying state
timeline.help.toggleInspector: Open or close the Inspector on the selection
timeline.help.zoomHere: Zoom to five minutes either side of here
timeline.help.zoomKeys: Zoom in / out / reset, anchored on the selection
confirm.deleteProjectChain: Every event and the whole SHA-256 evidence chain
confirm.deleteProjectMedia: All screenshots and terminal session recordings
confirm.deleteProjectAnchors: The OpenTimestamps receipts — these cannot be regenerated, because they attest to a moment that has passed
statusBar.tierCountTitle: {{chained}} chained (the audit chain) · {{logged}} logged (supporting evidence). Click to hide the logged rows on the Timeline — open the Timeline first, or the click does nothing.
screenshots.emptyReason: Periodic capture is off and nothing has been captured by hand yet. Every screenshot carries a SHA-256 and the reason it was taken.
loot.emptyReason: Credentials and keys are detected in command output and clipboard content as they go past. Nothing has matched yet — which is the expected state at the start of an engagement.
targets.emptyReason: Hosts and addresses are extracted from commands, HTTP traffic and DNS queries as they are captured. Nothing has been seen yet — run something against a host and it will appear.
bookmarks.emptyReason: Bookmarks are your own browsing notes — the URL and title of the tab you are on, saved so you can come back to it. They are not evidence: not chained, not signed, editable, deletable, and not in the evidence bundle. For a finding that belongs in the record, drop a marker (⌘⇧M).
transcript.emptyReason: This is what you typed and what came back, in order. It fills from shell commands, agent turns and HTTP exchanges as they are captured.
palette.title: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Go to a view, run an action, or search events…
palette.timelineScoped: Search within the loaded timeline (lanes, operators, hosts)
search.hint: Type at least 2 characters to search across all events
export.title: Export
castSearch.heading: Terminal recordings
castSearch.openAtMoment: Open the timeline at this moment
castSearch.unreadable: That part of the recording could not be read — the file may have been pruned or moved.
castSearch.stillIndexing: {{pending}} recording(s) not read yet. Results are incomplete until indexing finishes.
castSearch.tokenNote: Matches whole words and word beginnings, not text inside a word.
settings.handoffProfileHint: Writes this project’s scope, operators, capture settings and saved timeline views to one file. A teammate imports it when creating their project.
httpHistory.title: HTTP History
httpHistory.openAtMoment: Open the timeline at this moment
settings.connectionMonitorEnableHint: Polls the socket table and records who you connected to — IP, port, protocol, duration. No payload, no root. Fills the gap the proxy cannot see: SMB, RDP, reverse shells, C2 beacons.
settings.connectionMonitorSynNote: Established connections only. A SYN scan (nmap -sS) completes no handshake and will not appear — the command is still recorded, the connections are not.
timeline.detail.httpBodyEvicted: Body content no longer on disk — pruned by retention or evicted under disk pressure. The event and its SHA-256 remain; only the openable body is gone.
settings.transcriptTailerEnableHint: Windows only. Captures full command output without the Redlog-Run prefix by following a PowerShell transcript file. Add hooks/start-transcript-hook.ps1 to your $PROFILE, then turn this on.
marker.field.title: Title
marker.amendKeysHint: Enter / ⌘↩ to write · Esc to cancel · there is no undo — amend again
marker.amendErr.notFound: That marker is not here; it may belong to another project.
marker.amendErr.notAMarker: Only a marker can be amended, and an amendment cannot be amended again.
marker.amendErr.invalidChanges: Nothing in this edit can be written.
marker.amendErr.noActiveProject: No project is open, so nothing can be written.
marker.amendedTimesHint: each amendment is its own chained event; the original is unchanged
marker.amendNoApplicable: This amendment changes nothing that can be applied
marker.readonly.heading: Cannot be changed
marker.readonly.atTimestampWhy: where the operator dropped it; moving it moves the evidence
marker.readonly.categoryWhy: this turn opens title, severity and notes
marker.readonly.operatorWhy: who wrote it down is part of the record
marker.readonly.screenshotWhy: a screenshot is its own chained event pointing back at this marker
marker.readonly.sourceEventWhy: the event this marker points at, unchanged by an amendment
marker.readonly.hashWhy: the row's fingerprint; one changed character breaks it
scope.judged.retroactiveHint: judged by a scope recompute, not at the time it ran
scope.clearedHint: a later scope change withdrew this violation; the record is kept
scope.recompute.truncated: {{count}} more were not written row by row (cap {{cap}} per run)
settings.showAllPagesHint: By default only pages with data in them are listed; the rest stay reachable from ⌘K. Ticking this shows them all (this project only).
firstRun.title: Run one command
firstRun.hint: Type a command with a target in the terminal below. The strip on the right shows it being recorded.
firstRun.waitingHint: Run a command — nmap -sV 10.0.0.5, say — and it will appear here.
firstRun.stuckTitle: A command ran, but nothing arrived
firstRun.stuckWhy: The built-in terminal's capture hook needs python3 and curl. Without either the command still runs, but it is not recorded.
marker.readonly.urlWhy: where the mark points; changing it changes what it points at
